definition: Colocation and hyperscale data centre facilities of 1 MW design capacity or above, plus nationally announced cloud or AI compute programmes, publicly announced and traceable to a named source. Enterprise self-build, sub-1 MW sites and unannounced facilities are out of scope in this version. The definition is published so coverage can be judged against it, and it will be revised in the open.
unit: MW (capacity) and USD (capital). The two are never summed.

status_key.under_construction: Building, with a stated target date
status_key.approved: Planning consent or licence granted; not yet building
status_key.announced: Publicly announced by a sponsor or government; no consent evidence yet
status_key.exploring: Discussions or bidding reported; nothing committed
status_key.funding: Capital raised for a portfolio, not a single site
